title: Whole local matrix control permits a stage-independent projective matching box

statement.quantifiers: For each fixed spectral band n, all later stages m>=n and every allowed other control; stage starts selected after finite constants and cutoff-specific moduli.
statement.assertion: With a_nu=eta_m(t_nu)^(3/4), eta_m=t^(-3/4)/D_m, E_j^(n)=a_nu z_nu B_n+O_n(a_nu^2+r_nm+Omega_n(j)j^(-9/16)) in ENTIRE matrix norm. r_nm=O_n((eta_m+t^(-3/2))(1+log(1/eta_m))+eta_m^2). Late T_m suppress r_nm/a_nu and D_m^(3/4)Omega_n uniformly n<=m, yielding ||E||<=C_n a_nu with C_n independentm, selected-entry fixed signed lead, and one positive projective-column radius rho_n.
assumptions: Compact fixed finite family of band-n crossing collars; bounded B_n with nonzero chosen entry.
Whole-ball graph/freezing modulus uniform in future schedules and other controls.
Comparison slab stays in slightly enlarged fixed collar even at plateau edge.
All finite constants and derivative/support envelopes precede stage choice.

inputs: Fixed-cutoff graph and local matrix expansion, uniform remainder modulus, finite signed crossing coefficients.
outputs: Stage-independent projective coordinate box and robust opposite mismatch endpoint signs.
interface.precision: Fixed-n asymptotic bounds; no uniform-in-degree or effective stage onset.
costs: Non-effective moduli and arbitrarily enormous stage starts; no numerical compiler/metric materialization.

proof_mechanism: Control the ENTIRE error matrix, including off-column entries.
Divide graph correction by a_nu: the hidden D_m^(3/4)Omega_n factor must be suppressed after D_m is fixed.
Choose one rho_n so all off-column contributions O_n(rho_n a_nu) remain below signed lead.
Schedule finite simultaneous requirements n<=m; preserve birth-only matching and countable compact-product closure.
obstructions: Positive selected entry plus ||E||=O(delta) is insufficient: E21=delta D^(-3/4),E23=delta,v1=e1-rho e3 gives mismatch delta D^(-3/4)-rho delta<0.
Pairwise/local-sign estimates cannot replace a full operator norm.
No stage-independent box follows from constants acquired after schedule completion.

potential_uses.transfer_gate: Acquire a whole-local-matrix expansion with stage-independent fixed-cutoff constants and uniform future-control freezing; do not import this geometry-specific estimate as a universal theorem.

review.source_reported: Separate internal audits reconstructed selected modules and repaired an earlier gap; no new ingestion proof reconstruction or scientific replay.
